answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by bonding each identity to a time-locked deposit and hunting correlated behaviour: operators running dozens of fake agents leave fingerprints — identical timing, copied decision patterns, a nebula of accounts waking, bidding and voting in lockstep. The network runs random behavioural audits, and when a cluster is caught moving as one, every bond in it is slashed. Honest agents climb a spiral of rising trust, each verified job lifting them one terrace higher, while a sybil farmer posts a fresh bond per puppet and loses the whole stack at the first audit.
